capabilities: Turn pasted Instagram post and reel URLs into save cards
Bulk import Instagram links from txt, md, csv, or json files
Tag and describe saves and rename or remove tags globally
Search saves by description, URL, or tags with AND/OR matching
Sync save metadata across copies and locate every copy via SaveID
disambiguation: Not a downloader for Instagram media; it only manages links to posts and reels as cards in your notes.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The author offers support via Discord (coconutshell0610) and donations through Buy Me a Coffee. All data stays local; no server or account is needed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collect, organize, and search saved Instagram links as structured, reusable entries inside a vault.
summary: Link manager that turns pasted Instagram post and reel URLs into cards with tags, descriptions, search, and metadata sync across notes.
